offerings.name: Google Search API (SERP API)
offerings.pricing: Top-up model, no monthly subscriptions. Starter $50/50k credits ($1.00/1k); Standard $375/500k ($0.75/1k); Scale $1250/2.5M ($0.50/1k); Ultimate $3750/12.5M ($0.30/1k). Excluding sales tax/VAT/GST.
offerings.free_quota: Get 2,500 free queries（No credit card required）
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（JSON，含 organic/news/images/places/videos/shopping/scholar/patents/autocomplete 等）
offerings.note: 实时查询 Google，不缓存；结果 1-2 秒返回；按档位支持 50-300 queries per second；可自定义查询国家与语言；credits 有效期 6 个月。
